name: German Voice
desc:
Welcome to German Voice!

Join a fun and friendly space where you can connect with others, chat comfortably, and let your voice be heard! Whether you're here to enjoy great talks, share what’s on your mind, or just chill and make friends, German Voice is the perfect spot for you.

👍🏼 Like the game to stay updated on new features and updates!
⚠️ If you encounter toxic players or exploiters, feel free to report them on our community server.

🔊 (VC) Voice chat is highly recommended, but not required!
⭐ VR is supported!

⚠️ DISCLAIMER ⚠️
We are not responsible for any actions taken by other players during or outside of this experience. To report an issue or incident, please join our Community Server and submit a support ticket.
